name: Hivites
overview: The Hivites were a tribe of Canaanites, dwelling near Lebanon and included families such as the Shechemites and Gibeonites. Scripture records that Esau intermarried with Hivite women, demonstrating their presence and interactions with the patriarchal families. God commanded the Israelites to conquer and drive out the Hivites along with other Canaanite nations, as seen in the promise of land and the instructions given to Joshua. These passages highlight the Hivites as part of the broader Canaanite context from which God delivered His people, underscoring His sovereign plan in fulfilling His promises to Israel.
